verification_candidates.rationale: A causal link between chronic stress and metabolic syndrome that can be checked.

verification_candidates.rationale: A causal stress-to-dementia risk claim that can be checked against the literature.

verification_candidates.evidence_quote: And women are twice as likely as men to develop Alzheimer's disease.
verification_candidates.rationale: A specific sex-difference prevalence figure checkable against Alzheimer's epidemiology.
